explanation: Continuous second partials require (f_x)_y=(f_y)_x. I gives -4y versus -2y, which cannot agree throughout an open set. II gives 0 on both sides; a function exists by integrating the separate functions of x and y. III gives 6x²y on both sides and is realized by f=x³y²-(2/3)y^(3/2) on y>0. Thus II and III only are valid.
